snapshot-default.replenishment.summary.title: 分仓补货完整范围汇总 日汇总读取
snapshot-default.replenishment.summary.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

inventory.detail.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

inventory.count.title: 库存与目标筛选后总数
inventory.count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

inventory.summary.title: 库存与目标全范围汇总
inventory.summary.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 汇总不受列表分页参数影响。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

ELSE NULL END AS known_target_gap, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.inventory) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(r.inventory) >= 0 AND MIN(r.daily_demand) >= 0 AND SUM(r.daily_demand) > 0 THEN SUM(r.inventory) / inventory.groups.title: 库存与目标分层汇总分页
inventory.groups.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

inventory.groups_count.title: 库存与目标分层分组总数
inventory.groups_count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

inventory.options.title: 库存与目标级联筛选选项
inventory.options.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 取某字段选项时将该字段筛选mode置all，保留父级条件；NULL也是一个选项。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

inventory.options_count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

health.count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。 2026-11-10新来源：当前库存及调拨数量读取agents_scm_warehouse_total_data_d；货龄批次、月度计划保持各自原来源。

inventory.detail.atomic.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 D96业务确认：既有唯一版本聚合后的目标为空且同范围日均需求非负时，按日均需求×9派生展示目标；真实0不替换，日均需求缺失或重复版本保持未知；不回写上游。 D101：唯一基地/月/版本/SKU日均为空时，按同版本销售计划+调拨出库计划×0.5除该计划月自然天数补齐；缺任一要素或重复则保留未知；有效0保留。 D101/D114：同一基地与月份整体选版，纠偏→月初、月初→滚动；已选版本缺SKU、NULL、0或重复均不借用另一版本字段。 同月/版本/基地/SKU的重复目标逐字段核一致性；全非空且唯一值才取一次，冲突或空值混合保留未知，不累加重复目标。

transfer_plan.detail.atomic.notes: 以stat_month（YYYYMM）匹配所选自然月，数量按件原值使用。本月出货取warehouse_month_out_plan，次月出货取warehouse_future30_qty；同月仓库SKU重复保持未知。出货计划不依赖预留快照、版本或单位字段。独立月调拨计划没有真实来源，保留NULL，不用出货量或调拨中量替代；不阻断有效出货计划和历史动销测算。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。 当前调拨在途与备单按本月分仓计划登记值统计，分别采用transfer_onway_qty和transfer_prepare_qty，单位件；不从历史执行单累计反推。同仓SKU重复一致值取一次，冲突、缺失和负值逐字段保持未知，正常记录继续统计。

base_shipments.detail.title: 基地实际发货
base_shipments.detail.notes: 以工厂发货来源plant_flag=工厂为范围，按实际发货日期汇总；正向量、负向量（负数量绝对值）和净量分列。保留未知基地组，不把分仓再次计入工厂发货。无本期记录保持空，不用30日日均乘30；数量先在SQL按基地SKU汇总。此来源为发货，不代表完整出库或库存周转。

request.sql:
WITH factory_shipments AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(t.belong_base),'') AS base,t.material_code AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 AND t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN CASE WHEN t.act_dl_qty>0 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS month_ship_positive,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 AND t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS month_ship_net,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 AND t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN CASE WHEN t.act_dl_qty<0 THEN -t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS month_ship_negative,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS month_records,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2002 THEN CASE WHEN t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END) AS month_missing_qty,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 AND t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN CASE WHEN t.act_dl_qty>0 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS rolling_ship_positive,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 AND t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS rolling_ship_net,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 AND t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN CASE WHEN t.act_dl_qty<0 THEN -t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS rolling_ship_negative,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS rolling_records,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2003 THEN CASE WHEN t.act_dl_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END) AS rolling_missing_qty,
 MIN(t.act_ship_date) AS first_ship_date,MAX(t.act_ship_date) AS last_ship_date,COUNT(*) AS source_rows
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS t
 WHERE t.plant_flag='工厂' AND t.act_ship_date>=:gea_p2000 AND t.act_ship_date<:gea_p2001
 GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(t.belong_base),''),t.material_code
), filtered AS (
 SELECT s.base AS base, s.sku AS sku, s.material_name AS material_name, s.category AS category, s.month_ship_positive AS month_ship_positive, s.month_ship_net AS month_ship_net, s.month_ship_negative AS month_ship_negative, s.rolling_ship_positive AS rolling_ship_positive, s.rolling_ship_net AS rolling_ship_net, s.rolling_ship_negative AS rolling_ship_negative, s.month_records AS month_records, s.month_missing_qty AS month_missing_qty, s.rolling_records AS rolling_records, s.rolling_missing_qty AS rolling_missing_qty, s.first_ship_date AS first_ship_date, s.last_ship_date AS last_ship_date, s.source_rows AS source_rows
 FROM factory_shipments AS s WHERE (:gea_p2010=FALSE OR s.base IN (:gea_p2011)) AND (:gea_p2012 IS NULL OR s.sku=:gea_p2012)

batch-age.atomic.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。 2026-11-10新来源：当前库存及调拨数量读取agents_scm_warehouse_total_data_d；货龄批次、月度计划保持各自原来源。

replenishment-suggestions.detail.notes: 当前需求来自分仓下游有效未完成客户订单；按仓库和SKU扣减一次可用库存计算缺口，ASN不计入客户订单。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。 当前调拨在途、备单和调拨中量取分仓总量表对应字段，单位件，不从历史执行单累计反推。 2026-11-10新来源：当前库存及调拨数量读取agents_scm_warehouse_total_data_d；货龄批次、月度计划保持各自原来源。

IS NULL GROUP BY t.warehouseid, t.material_code) AS t ON t.warehouseid = e.warehouseid AND t.material_code = e.material_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.executeorderno AS executeorderno, o.executeorderlineno AS executeorderlineno, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_name) = 1 THEN MAX(o.cust_name) END AS cust_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.material_name) = 1 THEN MAX(o.material_name) END AS material_name customer_execution AS e INNER JOIN customer_execution_keys AS k ON (e.executeorderno = k.executeorderno AND e.executeorderlineno = k.executeorderlineno) AND (COALESCE(e.organizationid, '') = COALESCE(k.organizationid, '') AND COALESCE(e.ownerid, '') = COALESCE(k.ownerid, '')) INNER JOIN customer_warehouses AS w ON e.warehouseid = w.warehouse_code WHERE (k.versions = 1 AND e.detailstatus = 10 AND e.order_close_time IS NULL AND e.wms_close_time IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(e.dmscanceltime AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND (e.prapare_order_status IS >= 0 AND e.qtyallocated >= 0 AND e.qtyshipped >= 0 AND (e.order_type IS NULL OR NOT e.order_type IN ('ZUB', 'ZO14', 'TT', 'TT1', 'TT2', 'STO'))) AND (e.adjust_order_qty >= 0 AND e.pack_unitqty >= 0 AND e.delivery_qty >= 0)), customer_open_orders AS (SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, l.order_no AS order_no, l.customer_code AS customer_code FROM customer_valid_lines AS l GROUP BY l.material_name) = 1 THEN MAX(l.material_name) END AS material_name, MIN(l.created_at) AS created_at, MIN(l.requested_at) AS requested_at, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_status) = 1 THEN MAX(l.order_status) END AS order_status, SUM(l.ordered) AS ordered, SUM(l.demand) AS demand, SUM(l.allocated) AS allocated, SUM(l.shipped) AS shipped, CASE WHEN SUM(l.demand) > SUM(l.allocated) THEN SUM(l.demand) - SUM(l.allocated) ELSE 0 END AS remaining FROM customer_valid_lines AS l INNER JOIN customer_open_orders AS o ON l.warehouse_code = o.warehouse_code AND l.order_no = o.order_no AND (l.customer_code = o.customer_code OR (l.customer_code IS NULL AND o.customer_code IS NULL)) GROUP BY l.warehouse_code, l.warehouse_name, l.base, l.order_no, l.customer_code, l.sku), WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.live_qty) END AS live_qty, freeze_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_onway_qty) END AS transfer_onway_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_prepare_qty) END AS transfer_prepare_qty FROM agents_scm_warehouse_total_data_d AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.warehouseid), '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') p.warehouse_code AND l.sku = p.sku AND p.remaining > 0 AND (COALESCE(CAST(p.created_at AS VARCHAR), '') < COALESCE(CAST(l.created_at AS VARCHAR), '') OR (COALESCE(CAST(p.created_at AS VARCHAR), '') = COALESCE(CAST(l.created_at AS VARCHAR), '') AND p.order_no < l.order_no) OR (COALESCE(CAST(p.created_at AS VARCHAR), '') = COALESCE(CAST(l.created_at AS VARCHAR), '') AND p.order_no = l.order_no AND COALESCE(p.customer_code, '') < COALESCE(l.customer_code, ''))) WHERE l.remaining > 0 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code, l.order_no, l.customer_code, l.sku), customer_current_lines AS (SELECT l.warehouse_code material_name, l.created_at AS created_at, l.requested_at AS requested_at, l.order_status AS order_status, l.ordered AS ordered, l.demand AS demand, l.allocated AS allocated, l.shipped AS shipped, l.remaining AS remaining, CASE WHEN l.remaining = 0 THEN 0 WHEN i.sku IS NULL OR NOT i.available IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.available, 0) <= COALESCE(p.prior_remaining, 0) THEN l.remaining WHEN i.available >= COALESCE(p.prior_remaining, 0) + l.remaining THEN 0 ELSE l.remaining - i.available + COALESCE(p.prior_remaining, 0) END END AS shortage FROM customer_open_lines AS l LEFT JOIN customer_prior AS p ON l.warehouse_code = p.warehouse_code AND l.order_no = p.order_no AND l.sku = p.sku AND (l.customer_code = p.customer_code OR (l.customer_code IS NULL AND p.customer_code IS LOWER(l.warehouse_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7)) GROUP BY l.warehouse_code, l.order_no, l.customer_code HAVING (:gea_p4 = FALSE OR (SUM(l.shortage) > 0)) AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(l.order_no) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p3) OR LOWER(l.customer_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p3) OR LOWER(l.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p3) OR LOWER(l.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)), page_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_scope_total, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.sku_count) END AS scope_sku_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.ordered) END AS scope_ordered, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.demand) END AS scope_demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.allocated) END AS scope_allocated, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.shipped) END AS scope_shipped, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.remaining) END AS scope_remaining, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(g.shortage) END AS scope_shortage FROM order_groups AS g), page_rows AS (SELECT g.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, g.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, g.order_no AS order_no, g.customer_code AS customer_code, g.customer_name AS customer_name, g.requested_at AS requested_at, g.created_at AS created_at, g.ordered AS ordered, g.demand AS demand, g.allocated AS allocated, g.shipped AS shipped, g.remaining AS remaining, g.shortage AS shortage, g.sku_count AS sku_count, g.satisfaction AS satisfaction, g.order_status AS order_status, 1 AS page_row_present FROM order_groups AS g ORDER BY g.created_at DESC NULLS FIRST, g.warehouse_code NULLS LAST, g.order_no NULLS LAST, g.customer_code NULLS LAST LIMIT :gea_p5 OFFSET :gea_p6) SELECT p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, p.order_no AS order_no, p.customer_code AS customer_code, p.customer_name AS customer_name, p.requested_at AS requested_at, p.created_at AS created_at, p.ordered AS ordered, p.demand AS demand, p.allocated AS allocated, p.shipped AS shipped, p.remaining AS remaining, p.shortage AS shortage, p.sku_count AS sku_count, p.satisfaction AS satisfaction, p.order_status AS order_status, p.page_row_present AS page_row_present, n.page_scope_total AS page_scope_total, n.scope_sku_count AS scope_sku_count, n.scope_ordered AS scope_ordered, n.scope_demand AS scope_demand, n.scope_allocated AS scope_allocated, n.scope_shipped AS scope_shipped, n.scope_remaining AS scope_remaining, n.scope_shortage AS scope_shortage FROM page_count AS n LEFT JOIN page_rows AS p ON TRUE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC NULLS FIRST, p.warehouse_code NULLS LAST, p.order_no NULLS LAST, p.customer_code NULLS LAST

branch-supply.summary.title: 基地向分仓供货订单
branch-supply.summary.grain: receiving warehouse × execute order × line × SKU
branch-supply.summary.notes: 分仓向基地补货的执行侧；receive_wh为收货分仓，warehouseid为发货仓。只读小时执行源；排除作废明细与取消单；按执行单行取最新加载，冲突保持未知。CS数量使用原始EA除包装转换率。月度满足率=同池逐行限额发货量合计/订货量合计；当前池为全部未发或未收完成行，跨月保留。

request.sql:
WITH supply_scoped AS (
 SELECT e.receive_wh AS warehouse_code, e.executeorderno AS order_no, e.executeorderlineno AS line_no, e.material_code AS sku, e.material_name AS material_name, e.warehouseid AS base_warehouse, e.belong_base AS base, e.order_type AS order_type, e.header_addtime AS created_at, e.load_time AS source_updated_at, e.qtyordered AS ordered_ea, e.qtyshipped AS shipped_ea, e.qtysigned AS signed_ea, e.qtyallocated AS allocated_ea, e.packingunitconvertrate AS conversion_rate, e.packingunitmain AS quantity_unit, e.prapare_order_status AS order_status, e.detailstatus AS detail_status, e.orderstatus AS header_status, e.canceltime AS cancel_time, e.bizflowstatus AS flow_status
 FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d AS e
 WHERE e.order_type IN (:gea_p7)
 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.receive_wh),'') IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.receive_wh)<>'*'
 AND e.header_addtime<CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 AND (:gea_p6='current' OR e.header_addtime>=CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE))
 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR e.receive_wh=:gea_p3)
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR e.material_code=:gea_p4)
), supply_latest AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.order_no AS order_no, s.line_no AS line_no, s.sku AS sku, MAX(s.source_updated_at) AS latest_update
 FROM supply_scoped AS s GROUP BY s.warehouse_code, s.order_no, s.line_no, s.sku
), supply_records AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.order_no AS order_no, s.line_no AS line_no, s.sku AS sku, s.material_name AS material_name, s.base_warehouse AS base_warehouse, s.base AS base, s.order_type AS order_type, s.created_at AS created_at, s.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, s.ordered_ea AS ordered_ea, s.shipped_ea AS shipped_ea, s.signed_ea AS signed_ea, s.allocated_ea AS allocated_ea, s.conversion_rate AS conversion_rate, s.quantity_unit AS quantity_unit, s.order_status AS order_status, s.detail_status AS detail_status, s.header_status AS header_status, s.cancel_time AS cancel_time, s.flow_status AS flow_status
 FROM supply_scoped AS s INNER JOIN supply_latest AS k ON (s.warehouse_code=k.warehouse_code OR (s.warehouse_code IS NULL AND k.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (s.order_no=k.order_no OR (s.order_no IS NULL AND k.order_no IS NULL)) AND (s.line_no=k.line_no OR (s.line_no IS NULL AND k.line_no IS NULL)) AND (s.sku=k.sku OR (s.sku IS NULL AND k.sku IS NULL))
 AND (s.source_updated_at=k.latest_update OR (s.source_updated_at IS NULL AND k.latest_update IS NULL))
), supply_lines AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.order_no AS order_no, s.line_no AS line_no, s.sku AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.base_warehouse) ELSE NULL END AS base_warehouse, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.base) ELSE NULL END AS base, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.order_type) ELSE NULL END AS order_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.created_at) ELSE NULL END AS created_at, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.ordered_ea) ELSE NULL END AS ordered_ea, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.shipped_ea) ELSE NULL END AS shipped_ea, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.signed_ea) ELSE NULL END AS signed_ea, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.allocated_ea) ELSE NULL END AS allocated_ea, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.conversion_rate) ELSE NULL END AS conversion_rate, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.quantity_unit) ELSE NULL END AS quantity_unit, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.order_status) ELSE NULL END AS order_status, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.detail_status) ELSE NULL END AS detail_status, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.header_status) ELSE NULL END AS header_status, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.cancel_time) ELSE NULL END AS cancel_time, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.flow_status) ELSE NULL END AS flow_status, MAX(s.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at,
 COUNT(*) AS source_versions
 FROM supply_records AS s GROUP BY s.warehouse_code, s.order_no, s.line_no, s.sku
), supply_quantities AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.order_no AS order_no, s.line_no AS line_no, s.sku AS sku, s.material_name AS material_name, s.base_warehouse AS base_warehouse, s.base AS base, s.order_type AS order_type, s.created_at AS created_at, s.order_status AS order_status, s.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, s.source_versions AS source_versions,
 CASE WHEN s.source_versions=1 AND s.quantity_unit='CS' AND s.conversion_rate>0 AND s.ordered_ea>=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.order_no),'') IS NOT NULL AND s.line_no IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.sku),'') IS NOT NULL THEN s.ordered_ea/CAST(s.conversion_rate AS DECIMAL(20,6)) ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN s.source_versions=1 AND s.quantity_unit='CS' AND s.conversion_rate>0 AND s.shipped_ea>=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.order_no),'') IS NOT NULL AND s.line_no IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.sku),'') IS NOT NULL THEN s.shipped_ea/CAST(s.conversion_rate AS DECIMAL(20,6)) ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN s.source_versions=1 AND s.quantity_unit='CS' AND s.conversion_rate>0 AND s.signed_ea>=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.order_no),'') IS NOT NULL AND s.line_no IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.sku),'') IS NOT NULL THEN s.signed_ea/CAST(s.conversion_rate AS DECIMAL(20,6)) ELSE NULL END AS received, CASE WHEN s.source_versions=1 AND s.quantity_unit='CS' AND s.conversion_rate>0 AND s.allocated_ea>=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.order_no),'') IS NOT NULL AND s.line_no IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(s.sku),'') IS NOT NULL THEN s.allocated_ea/CAST(s.conversion_rate AS DECIMAL(20,6)) ELSE NULL END AS allocated
 FROM supply_lines AS s
 WHERE s.source_versions>1 OR (s.detail_status=10
 AND (s.header_status IS NULL OR s.header_status<>90)
 AND (s.cancel_time IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(s.cancel_time),'') IS NULL)
 AND (s.flow_status IS NULL OR s.flow_status<>'作废'))
), supply_measured AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.order_no AS order_no, s.line_no AS line_no, s.sku AS sku, s.material_name AS material_name, s.base_warehouse AS base_warehouse, s.base AS base, s.order_type AS order_type, s.created_at AS created_at, s.order_status AS order_status, s.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, s.source_versions AS source_versions, s.demand AS demand, s.shipped AS shipped, s.received AS received, s.allocated AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN s.demand IS NULL OR s.shipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.demand>s.shipped THEN s.demand-s.shipped ELSE 0 END AS pending,
 CASE WHEN s.shipped IS NULL OR s.received IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.shipped>s.received THEN s.shipped-s.received ELSE 0 END AS in_transit,
 CASE WHEN s.demand IS NULL OR s.shipped IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.shipped>s.demand THEN s.demand ELSE s.shipped END AS fulfilled,
 CASE WHEN s.shipped IS NULL OR s.demand IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.shipped>0 THEN s.demand ELSE 0 END AS shipped_order_quantity
 FROM supply_quantities AS s
), supply_filtered AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.order_no AS order_no, s.line_no AS line_no, s.sku AS sku, s.material_name AS material_name, s.base_warehouse AS base_warehouse, s.base AS base, s.order_type AS order_type, s.created_at AS created_at, s.order_status AS order_status, s.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, s.source_versions AS source_versions, s.demand AS demand, s.shipped AS shipped, s.received AS received, s.allocated AS allocated, s.pending AS pending, s.in_transit AS in_transit, s.fulfilled AS fulfilled, s.shipped_order_quantity AS shipped_order_quantity
 FROM supply_measured AS s
 WHERE (:gea_p6='month' OR s.pending>0 OR s.in_transit>0 OR s.pending IS NULL OR s.in_transit IS NULL)
 AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR LOWER(s.order_no) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p5) OR LOWER(s.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p5) OR LOWER(s.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p5))
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_no) AS order_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.demand) ELSE NULL END AS demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.shipped) ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.received)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.received) ELSE NULL END AS received, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.allocated) ELSE NULL END AS allocated, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.pending)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.pending) ELSE NULL END AS pending, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.in_transit)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.in_transit) ELSE NULL END AS in_transit, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(s.shipped_order_quantity)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(s.shipped_order_quantity) ELSE NULL END AS shipped_order_quantity, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.demand) AS missing_demand, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.shipped) AS missing_shipped, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.received) AS missing_received, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.allocated) AS missing_allocated, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.pending) AS missing_pending, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.in_transit) AS missing_in_transit, COUNT(*)-COUNT(s.shipped_order_quantity) AS missing_shipped_order_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(s.demand)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(s.fulfilled)=COUNT(*) AND SUM(s.demand)>0 THEN SUM(s.fulfilled)/SUM(s.demand) ELSE NULL END AS fulfillment_rate, MAX(s.source_updated_at) AS source_updated_at FROM supply_filtered AS s

warehouse-outbound.summary.title: 分仓本月实际出库（件）
warehouse-outbound.summary.grain: actual warehouse + execution order + execution line + SKU
warehouse-outbound.summary.notes: 按实际仓库编码匹配当前分仓目录，以WMS关单日期限定所选月截至日；delivery_qty为件，含赠品；不按提货点限定实际出库仓库，不使用qtyshipped基本数量或客户销售发货代替。重复订单行仅在数量一致时折叠，键缺失、负数或数量冲突保持缺失。 本月入库独立按出入库台账transactiontime统计in_qty，包含台账调整；不使用ASN累计实收量代替本月入库，入库缺失不影响WMS出库数量。 row_count以出库订单行计数，无出库时用入库来源行数保持入库结果可见。

/* inventory-branch-exclusions:N436,Y204 */
WITH latest_stock AS (
 SELECT MAX(b.month_date) AS stock_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
 WHERE ((b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.warehouseid NOT IN ('N436', 'Y204')))
 AND b.month_date <= REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p3 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), branch_scope AS (
 SELECT TRIM(b.warehouseid) AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
 INNER JOIN latest_stock AS s ON b.month_date = s.stock_date
 WHERE ((b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.warehouseid NOT IN ('N436', 'Y204')))
 AND NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NOT NULL
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR TRIM(b.warehouseid) = :gea_p4)
 GROUP BY TRIM(b.warehouseid)
), outbound_lines AS (
 SELECT b.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, NULLIF(TRIM(e.executeorderno), '') AS order_no,
 NULLIF(TRIM(e.executeorderlineno), '') AS line_no, NULLIF(TRIM(e.material_code), '') AS sku,
 COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(e.delivery_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.delivery_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(e.delivery_qty) ELSE NULL END AS outgoing_qty,
 MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS closed_at, MAX(e.load_time) AS loaded_at
 FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS e
 INNER JOIN branch_scope AS b ON TRIM(e.warehouseid) = b.warehouse_code
 WHERE e.wms_close_time >= CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND e.wms_close_time < CAST(:gea_p2 AS DATE)
 GROUP BY b.warehouse_code, NULLIF(TRIM(e.executeorderno), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(e.executeorderlineno), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(e.material_code), '')
), checked_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, l.sku AS sku, l.source_rows AS source_rows,
 l.closed_at AS closed_at, l.loaded_at AS loaded_at,
 CASE WHEN l.order_no IS NULL OR l.line_no IS NULL OR l.sku IS NULL OR l.outgoing_qty IS NULL OR l.outgoing_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid,
 CASE WHEN l.order_no IS NOT NULL AND l.line_no IS NOT NULL AND l.sku IS NOT NULL AND l.outgoing_qty >= 0 THEN l.outgoing_qty ELSE NULL END AS outgoing_qty
 FROM outbound_lines AS l
), incoming_totals AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(f.in_qty)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(f.in_qty) ELSE NULL END AS incoming_qty,
 COUNT(*) AS incoming_source_rows,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.in_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_missing_quantity_count,
 CAST(MAX(f.transactiontime) AS TEXT) AS latest_incoming_date
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS f
 WHERE ((f.warehouse_classify='20' AND f.warehouseid NOT IN ('N436', 'Y204')))

), outbound_totals AS (
SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.warehouse_code) AS warehouse_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT l.sku) AS sku_count,
 CASE WHEN SUM(l.invalid) = 0 THEN SUM(l.outgoing_qty) ELSE NULL END AS outgoing_qty,

 SUM(CASE WHEN l.source_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeated_line_count,

SELECT CASE WHEN o.row_count>0 THEN o.row_count ELSE m.incoming_source_rows END AS row_count, o.warehouse_count AS warehouse_count, o.sku_count AS sku_count, o.outgoing_qty AS outgoing_qty, o.known_outgoing_qty AS known_outgoing_qty, o.missing_quantity_count AS missing_quantity_count, o.repeated_line_count AS repeated_line_count, o.latest_close_time AS latest_close_time, o.source_load_time AS source_load_time,

 m.incoming_missing_quantity_count AS incoming_missing_quantity_count,

FROM outbound_totals AS o CROSS JOIN incoming_totals AS m

/* inventory-branch-exclusions:N436,Y204 */
WITH latest AS (SELECT REPLACE(MAX(CAST(m.stock_date AS VARCHAR(10))), '-', '') AS day_key FROM agents_inv_branch_sku_day AS m WHERE (m.inv_batch_id = :gea_p90001 AND m.inv_variant_id = 'BRANCH_AGE') AND (m.warehouseid IS NULL OR NOT m.warehouseid IN ('N436', 'Y204'))), quantities AS (SELECT m.warehouseid AS warehouseid, m.sku AS material_code, CAST(m.inventory_qty AS DECIMAL(38, 1)) AS total_qty, CAST(m.available_qty AS DECIMAL(38, 1)) AS available_qty, CAST(m.occupied_qty AS DECIMAL(38, 1)) AS pack_unit_qty, CAST(m.frozen_qty AS DECIMAL(38, 1)) AS freeze_qty FROM agents_inv_branch_sku_day AS m WHERE ((m.inv_batch_id = :gea_p90001) AND (m.inv_variant_id = 'BRANCH_AGE') AND ((:gea_p2 IS NULL OR :gea_p2 = '' OR m.warehouseid = :gea_p2))) AND (m.warehouseid IS NULL OR NOT m.warehouseid IN ('N436', 'Y204'))), inventory_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(q.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(q.available_qty) AS available_qty, SUM(q.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(q.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty FROM quantities AS q), original_parameter_contract AS (SELECT :gea_p1 AS bind_gea_p1) SELECT CASE WHEN l.day_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(l.day_key, 1, 4), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(l.day_key, 5, 2), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(l.day_key, 7, 2), '')) END AS day, i.row_count AS row_count, i.total_qty AS total_qty, i.available_qty AS available_qty, i.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, i.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty FROM latest AS l CROSS JOIN inventory_summary AS i

snapshot.source.branch-stock-date.notes: 日期保持全范围最新快照；库存按所选分仓过滤。日期读取仅要求 day 返回权限，库存卡片独立校验数量返回权限。

snapshot.replenishment.count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot.replenishment.summary.title: 分仓补货完整范围汇总 日汇总读取
snapshot.replenishment.summary.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot.replenishment.detail.atomic.title: 分仓补货明细与计数同语句 日汇总读取
snapshot.replenishment.detail.atomic.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot.replenishment-suggestions.detai.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot.replenishment-suggestions.detai.title: 分仓建议补货清单（沿页面测算，只列正建议量） 日汇总读取
snapshot.replenishment-suggestions.detai.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot-default.replenishment.count.title: 分仓补货完整范围计数 日汇总读取
snapshot-default.replenishment.count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot-default.replenishment-suggestio.title: 分仓建议补货清单（沿页面测算，只列正建议量） 日汇总读取
snapshot-default.replenishment-suggestio.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot-default.replenishment-suggestio.title: 分仓建议补货清单（沿页面测算，只列正建议量） 日汇总读取
snapshot-default.replenishment-suggestio.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

snapshot-default.replenishment-suggestio.title: 分仓建议补货清单（沿页面测算，只列正建议量） 日汇总读取
snapshot-default.replenishment-suggestio.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

agents_inv_branch_sku_day AS m WHERE (m.inv_variant_id = '__BRANCH_READY__' AND m.inv_rule_version = 'inventory-daily-v5-20261103' AND NOT m.warehouseid IS NULL) AND (m.warehouseid IS NULL OR NOT m.warehouseid IN ('N436', 'Y204')) GROUP BY m.inv_batch_id HAVING COUNT(m.stock_date) = COUNT(1) AND MIN(m.stock_date) = MAX(m.stock_date) AND COUNT(m.inv_business_date) = COUNT(1) AND MIN(m.inv_business_date) = MAX(m.inv_business_date) AND COUNT(m.stat_month) = COUNT(1) AND MIN(m.stat_month) = MAX(m.stat_month) ORDER BY m.inv_batch_id DESC LIMIT 1), b0_c0 AS (SELECT m.warehouseid snapshot-default.replenishment-confirmat.title: 分仓补货明细与计数同语句 日汇总读取
snapshot-default.replenishment-confirmat.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。

replenishment-confirmation.detail.atomic.title: 分仓补货明细与计数同语句
replenishment-confirmation.detail.atomic.notes: 当前需求来自分仓下游有效未完成客户订单；按仓库和SKU扣减一次可用库存计算缺口，ASN不计入客户订单。 D97：有业务包含当前及次月已发布调拨计划的正值活动；仅判定是否发生业务，不借此换算或填充计划数量；同仓SKU同月重复保持未知。 D120：同仓库/SKU/生产日期/快照先按有符号数量汇总，再对净正批次计算货龄、分段及风险；不跨SKU、仓库或生产日期冲抵。 当前调拨在途、备单和调拨中量取分仓总量表对应字段，单位件，不从历史执行单累计反推。 2026-11-10新来源：当前库存及调拨数量读取agents_scm_warehouse_total_data_d；货龄批次、月度计划保持各自原来源。

upstream-orders.detail.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

upstream-orders.count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

upstream-orders.summary.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

upstream-orders.groups.title: 订单业务期事实分层汇总分页
upstream-orders.groups.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

upstream-orders.groups_count.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

upstream-orders.options.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

upstream-orders.detail.atomic.title: 订单业务期事实明细分页
upstream-orders.detail.atomic.notes: 分仓向基地下单以ASN调拨入库为主体，warehouseid为收货分仓，source_warehouseid关联基地；状态00为未收货、90排除、99完成。按CRM源单号、来源仓、收货分仓和SKU关联基地出库单，出库占用按业务单位转换率换为件；ASN预期及实收原值为件。当前订单为ASN未收货量，基地占用扣除已收货并受当前需求上限约束。缺货按订单剩余需求、基地与SKU共享可用库存计算，按订单创建时间/执行单号/分仓编码稳定先后分配；分仓、SKU、搜索及分页在分配后筛选。缺失或冲突保持未知。

          ELSE COALESCE(SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE $1::text = '' OR f.material_code=$1),0) END AS quantity,

      SELECT

        SUM(i.live_qty) AS live_qty,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(i.available_qty)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available_qty,
        MAX(i.updated_time) AS updated_time
      FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_inventory_snapshot i
      JOIN latest ON latest.snapshot_date = i.snapshot_date
      WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(i.pickup_point), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(i.self_pickup_point), '')) = $1
      GROUP BY i.snapshot_date, i.material_code, i.prod_date

WITH scope_warehouses AS (

          AND COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(i.pickup_point), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(i.self_pickup_point), '')) = $1
      )
      SELECT
        o.snapshot_date::text AS snapshot_date,
        o.period_month::text AS period_month,
        o.business_date::text AS business_date,
        o.metric_group,
        o.metric_name,
        o.material_code,
        MAX(o.material_name) AS material_name,
        o.base_group_id,
        o.base_group_name,
        CASE WHEN (o.metric_group='branch_activity' OR o.metric_name IN ('in_transit_qty', 'verified_in_transit_qty')) AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.metric_value IS NULL OR o.metric_value < 0) > 0
          THEN NULL
          WHEN o.metric_group = 'warehouse_examine'
          THEN AVG(o.metric_value)
          ELSE SUM(o.metric_value)
        END AS metric_value,
        MAX(o.updated_time) AS updated_time
      FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_operation_fact o
      WHERE (
          COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.pickup_point), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(o.self_pickup_point), '')) = $1
          OR o.warehouseid = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT warehouseid FROM scope_warehouses))
        )
        AND (
          o.metric_name IN ('in_transit_qty', 'verified_in_transit_qty')

WITH latest AS (

        MAX(to_jsonb(p)->>'cust_name') AS cust_name,
        MAX(to_jsonb(p)->>'cust_code') AS cust_code,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT to_jsonb(p)->>'required_delivery_at')=1 THEN MAX(to_jsonb(p)->>'required_delivery_at') END AS required_delivery_at,
        SUM(p.allocated_qty) AS allocated_qty,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.order_stage IS NULL) AS legacy_count,
        MAX(p.updated_time) AS updated_time
      FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_pending_order p
